## Description

A ~150 µm ciliate with an enormous buccal cavity (almost the whole ventral side) with which it
swallows other ciliates whole, *Euplotes* among them. It releases a protein (kairomone) into the
water that makes *Euplotes octocarinatus* grow lateral wings and become too wide for its mouth.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 1 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A raptorial predator with a [released signal](../../mechanics/chemical-signals.md#m3--released-signal) that
diffuses in biological time, so the gradient has its real length (√(D·τ) ≈ 2 mm: in a drop it
reaches almost everywhere), and a `mouth_width` that the winged morph exceeds. Release rate,
diffusion, half-life and mouth opening estimated.
